content.about: South Korea occupies the southern half of the Korean Peninsula in East Asia, with mountains covering much of its land. Seoul is a giant, high-tech city mixing palaces with skyscrapers. Korean pop music, films and food have become hugely popular worldwide. Jeju Island, off its south coast, is a volcanic island with lava tubes.

standout.text: Hangul, the Korean alphabet, was created in 1443 under King Sejong.

didYouKnow: South Korea has some of the fastest internet speeds in the world.
Kimchi, fermented vegetables, is eaten at almost every Korean meal.
Taekwondo, a Korean martial art, is an Olympic sport.
